text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I see, you've still got paperwork after this, Trainer~?
Aren't you pushing yourself too hard?

text_block_list.name: Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
It's impossible~~! It's all over...!
How could I make such a blunder...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Uh-oh, looks like things aren't going so well over there?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I see, an ordering mistake, huh~
Selling 1,000 bottles of milk before the day ends
does sound pretty tough, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "Still, if it sells out, that just means business is booming, right? It's not all bad possibilities, no way!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Palmer-san will help out too!
I'll pay you back for always
giving me all those extras♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey, Ryan! Perfect timing!
Wanna buy some milk? You said you ran out of the stuff for your protein shakes, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You remembered that!? That's Palmer for you...!
I was just thinking I needed to buy one!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so I can buy in bulk?
Then... 10 packs, please!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo's gonna buy milk too!
I'll chug it down and run faster and faster!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, don't drink too much! You'll upset your stomach.
I'd recommend sticking to one or two glasses a day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Just by drinking it every day, you get plenty
of protein, calcium, and all sorts of nutrients,
and it's super easy too~!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Is that so?!
Milk is so convenient! And so easy!

text_block_list.name: Customer A
text_block_list.text:
My, milk really is amazing, isn't it~?
Maybe I should have my kid drink some too.
Hey, give me three cartons!

text_block_list.name: Customers
text_block_list.text:
Give me three packs too, please!
I'll take five packs over here!

text_block_list.name: Palmer Fan Underclassmen
text_block_list.text:
Palmer-senpai~! We all came!
Please give us 3 packs each!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you guys came?! I'm so seriously grateful!
Um, how many are there? 1, 2, 3, 4—

text_block_list.name: Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, can you go grab some from the back?!
Let's split up and get this restocked somehow!
And so, thanks to Mejiro Palmer, the milk sold smoothly, but—

text_block_list.name: Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
It's coming down, huh...!
Hey! Bring the storefront goods inside!

text_block_list.name: Store Manager
text_block_list.text: ...Achoo! Ugh... Now that the rain's stopped, it's gotten pretty chilly...
choice_data_list: That looks like it might affect sales...

text_block_list.name: Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks, both of you.
Man, you really helped me out a ton.

text_block_list.name: Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
It feels like a waste, but...
I guess I'll throw out what's left over...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Man, this weather is totally crazy~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, for real, it's insane!
This is our chance for a massive bestseller!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
No way I'm letting this chance slip by!
Boss, can I borrow some equipment?
First, a big pot, some white sugar, and...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: How about some hot milk~! It'll warm you right down to the core~!

text_block_list.name: Shopper A
text_block_list.text: Wah, it looks so warm! May I have a cup?

text_block_list.name: Shopper B
text_block_list.text:
Even with the sudden rain,
you were so well-prepared~! What a clever merchant you are~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much!
Alright, that's the last one! Which means—!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Sold out, yeaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Store Manager
text_block_list.text: "Thanks to you, I'm saved...! Truly, I don't know how to thank you!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
No need for thanks, really!
The milk sold, I got to be of help,
and everyone's happy, so it's all good!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
No need for thanks, really!
The milk sold, I got to be of help,
and everyone's happy, so it's all good!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, that was seriously the absolute best!
Helping out together made me so happy too!"

text_block_list.name: Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
"Man, thanks to you too, Trainer.
Helping me out even though you're busy with work and all."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Now, now!
Flattery will only get you a smile, you know~?

text_block_list.name: Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
"Man, thanks to you too, Trainer.
Helping me out even though you're busy with work and all."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Didn't you say we had paperwork today?!
Crap, my head was completely filled with milk...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "No, seriously, I'm so sorry!!"
choice_data_list: You can always do work anytime.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Well, ...mmngh...
Knowing you, I'm sure you mean it, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Anyway, I'm sorry! Seriously!
I'll be careful!"
Mejiro Palmer had an uncharacteristically glum look on her face.
